text:
maria: Drafting short release note for docs site. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/PR-5401. Highlights: policy-aware routing rollout, embedding dedup opt-in, Console per-route latency charts. Need quick review and any legal/comms flags.

devin: keep lead very short + three bullets with impact/who-it-affects.

sam: SDK compatibility note: streaming flag renamed in v0.9 (python/js). Add Known Issue + migration snippets for both. Also call out embedding dedup default behavior for older workspaces.

ellie: anchor rename from the refactor broke some links. I listed the 5 affected anchors in the PR comment and recommend redirects.

olivia: I'll open the redirect PR for `/docs/api/console#model-routing` -> `/docs/api/console#routing-policy`.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build passed. preview: https://staging.docs.redwood/releases/5401-preview

maria: added bullets, Known Issues, and a one-line "Migration note" for Dedicated customers about revalidating pinned model rollouts.

sam: python snippet to include:
```python
# pre-0.9
client.generate('p', stream=True)
# 0.9+
client.generate('p', enable_stream=True)
```

sam: JS snippet:
```js
// pre-0.9
client.generate('p', { stream: true })
// 0.9+
client.generate('p', { enableStream: true })
```

devin: timeline: send to product-marketing at 10:30, publish after noon if no blockers. Reply "LGTM" to approve.

maria: LGTM (pushed small wording tweak).

ellie: LGTM, will follow up with redirect PR.

olivia: LGTM, redirect PR opened.

sam: LGTM, syncing SDK snippets now.

maria: merging in 5m unless anyone objects. :shipit:
